source: The Lean verifier (verify --zk --partition --program) on today's flat statement of one block, one core, setup included, measured on vy-spot-prove's CPU for nine of GLM-5.3's proof-block types at TP8; peak resident memory measured for two of them, restaged and verified under perf on vy-nebius-cpu-2 (FlashInfer K2048, 99.6 GB, run r20261107-163607-8de4) and vy-nebius-cpu-6 (quant K6144, 111 GB, run r20261107-163659-b576), null where not measured. The time goes as about 10 s plus 0.6 to 0.8 µs a matrix entry of the unit, most of it reading the unrolled circuit file (hashing it three times, decoding and tokenizing every row). A family's other types scale on the line through its members, through 10 s at size 0 where it has one; the expert GEMMs and the all-reduces take their member's seconds; any other type the nine's median. Converted at the core-seconds that cost one GPU-second at Nebius AI Cloud's on-demand list prices.

value.verifier: Lean verify --zk --partition --program, today's flat statement, setup included
